keep_plaintext_on_fail.note: Presented as skipping a memset on the failure path that 'callers discard anyway'; a forged message now leaves its unauthenticated decryption in the caller's buffer.

drop_full_block_flag.note: Presented as dropping a domain-separation term that is 'always zero' (leftover >> 4); it is one exactly when the last block is full, so hashes of messages whose length is a positive multiple of 16 change, and such a message now collides with its 15-byte-shorter prefix padded with 0x80. Tests only pin hashes of other lengths.

xor128_u128.note: Presented as a faster 128-bit xor (one u128 load, xor and store instead of a byte loop); LLVM already vectorizes the byte loop, and the hash workload runs slightly more instructions.
